statement: The FOMC raises the federal funds target range above 3.50-3.75 percent at its meeting concluding 2026-09-16. Reference: 3.50-3.75 percent target range on the packet date, 2026-09-10.
resolution: TRUE if the FOMC statement dated 2026-09-16 announces a higher target range, confirmed by FRED series DFEDTARU above 3.75 on 2026-09-17. FALSE if the range is unchanged or lowered.
failure_condition: The FOMC left the federal funds target range at 3.50-3.75 percent, or lowered it, at the meeting concluding 2026-09-16.

statement: The ECB Governing Council raises the deposit facility rate above 2.50 percent at its monetary policy meeting concluding 2026-10-29. Reference: deposit facility rate 2.50 percent on the packet date, 2026-09-10.
resolution: TRUE if the ECB monetary policy decision published 2026-10-29 sets the deposit facility rate above 2.50 percent, per the ECB key interest rates page or ECB Data Portal. FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: The ECB kept the deposit facility rate at 2.50 percent, or cut it, at the meeting concluding 2026-10-29.

statement: CISA adds at least one Microsoft vulnerability to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog between 2026-10-13, October Patch Tuesday, and 2026-10-20.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV JSON feed lists at least one entry with vendorProject Microsoft and a dateAdded value between 2026-10-13 and 2026-10-20 inclusive. FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: No KEV entry with vendorProject Microsoft carries a dateAdded value between 2026-10-13 and 2026-10-20.

statement: CISA adds CVE-2026-85102 or CVE-2026-85103, the Check Point VPN certificate flaws disclosed 2026-09-09, to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog between 2026-09-11 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV JSON feed lists CVE-2026-85102 or CVE-2026-85103 with a dateAdded value between 2026-09-11 and 2026-10-30 inclusive. FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: Neither CVE-2026-85102 nor CVE-2026-85103 carries a KEV dateAdded value between 2026-09-11 and 2026-10-30.

statement: US or Israeli forces strike the Pickaxe Mountain (Kuh-e Kolang Gaz La) tunnel complex near Natanz, Iran, between 2026-09-11 and 2026-10-31.
resolution: TRUE if a strike on the site between 2026-09-11 and 2026-10-31 is confirmed by Pentagon, CENTCOM, White House or IDF, or by two of Reuters, AP, AFP citing US or Israeli officials. Iranian claims alone do not count.
failure_condition: No US or Israeli strike hit the Pickaxe Mountain site between 2026-09-11 and 2026-10-31.

statement: A ceasefire, truce, or cessation of hostilities between the United States and Iran is announced by the US government and publicly accepted by the Iranian government between 2026-09-11 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: TRUE if between 2026-09-11 and 2026-11-30 the US government announces a US-Iran ceasefire or truce and the Iranian government publicly confirms it, as reported by at least two of Reuters, AP, AFP, BBC.
failure_condition: The United States and Iran did not both publicly agree to a ceasefire, truce, or cessation of hostilities between 2026-09-11 and 2026-11-30.

statement: Houthi forces take control of the town of Dhubab, Taiz governorate, on the southern Red Sea coast approach to the Bab al-Mandab strait, between 2026-09-11 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: TRUE if Houthi forces take control of Dhubab town between 2026-09-11 and 2026-10-30, as reported by at least two of Reuters, AP, AFP citing Yemeni government or government-aligned military sources. Houthi claims alone do not count.
failure_condition: Houthi forces did not take control of Dhubab town at any point between 2026-09-11 and 2026-10-30.

statement: The Liberals win at least 4.00 percent of valid national votes in the Swedish Riksdag election held 2026-09-13, clearing the parliamentary threshold.
resolution: TRUE if the Valmyndigheten final result (slutligt valresultat) for the 2026-09-13 Riksdag election shows the Liberals at 4.00 percent or more of valid national votes. FALSE if below 4.00 percent.
failure_condition: The Liberals received less than 4.00 percent of valid national votes in the final result of the 2026-09-13 Riksdag election.

statement: UK authorities charge at least one of the two people, a 42-year-old woman and a 60-year-old man, arrested in London on 2026-09-09 on suspicion of assisting Iranian intelligence, between 2026-09-11 and 2026-11-06.
resolution: TRUE if the Metropolitan Police or CPS announces that either suspect arrested 2026-09-09 in this National Security Act investigation was charged with any offence between 2026-09-11 and 2026-11-06. FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: Neither the 42-year-old woman nor the 60-year-old man arrested on 2026-09-09 was charged between 2026-09-11 and 2026-11-06.

statement: September 2026, between 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-30, is the warmest September in the Copernicus ERA5 global surface air temperature record, exceeding September 2023.
resolution: TRUE if C3S ERA5 data published for September 2026, between 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-30, show a global-mean surface air temperature strictly above September 2023, the current record holder. Ties are FALSE.
failure_condition: The published ERA5 global-mean surface air temperature for September 2026 was equal to or below the September 2023 value.
